_comment: Where each survey's structured data comes from, one row per zone.
This replaced ten near-identical prose blocks on sources.html that each said
'Source warning. The wiki's X page was last edited...' in a slightly different
order. The facts are the same shape every time, so they belong in a table.
'not recorded' means we did not establish it, and it is written rather than
left blank so an empty cell can never be read as 'nothing to report'. Filling
one in takes one API call against the page's history.
p99_origin: the page began as a Project 1999 import. Per CLAUDE.md's provenance
test its prose is tier 5 until proven otherwise, however current the infobox is.

najena.note: One of ten edits made that morning. The Map section was expanded separately on 6 and 24 July. The freshest zone page in the project.

splitpaw.note: Six weeks before the revamp, so the page predates the changes it describes.

crushbone.note: Touched again on launch day, 28 July.

befallen.note: The survey recorded 7 June until 8 August. The footer was two months stale and the page had gained the Ebon Scythe in the meantime.

blackburrow.note: The August edits are images only, so the content dates from 4 July.

lowerguk.note: Five revisions since import. An earlier revision was served on first fetch and had to be diffed against the current one — that check is what surfaced the respawn correction.

nagafenslair.note: Infobox and the NPC and item tables are live Legends data. Dangers, Benefits and Traveling remain imported prose.

thehole.note: Edited six times that day. The survey had recorded 15 July, three weeks behind. Slizik the Mighty gained a coordinate in the gap.

warrens.note: Oldest revision by P99Wiki>MalleSnow. Three edits since. A Project 1999 import by the provenance test, and the survey says so in prose.

mistmoore.note: Titled Mistmoore Castle on the wiki, not Castle Mistmoore. Infobox and tables are live Legends data; the narrative is classic prose written in the first person by a Project 1999 contributor.
